Build it in P5.js with a slider for the projection angle — the pedagogical move is that the learner *rotates the light themselves* and watches Creation/Tools/Philosophy/Practice deform into one another. A second, more austere option: a **single white unit cell tiled through a wallpaper group** (p4m or p6m), where toggling symmetry operations on/off collapses the pattern back to the fundamental domain — same lesson (symmetry generates apparent multiplicity from unity), closer to the Kaleidoscope/Crystal section already in the body. I'd lean tesseract for emotional punch, wallpaper for intellectual precision. Want me to draft a rewrite of the Visual Identity section around one of these once you pick?
